svg.title: Figure 35.2 — Monthly Priority Matrix
svg.desc: Generalised twelve-month priority matrix for a temperate Northern Hemisphere planning model.
svg.text: This matrix organises work but does not turn months into prescriptions. Shift the sequence for hemisphere,
Generalised intensity: 0 = usually low · 1 = review / conditional · 2 = commonly higher priority
Health rows indicate monitoring priority only; they do not imply a treatment product, threshold or authorised schedule.
